VERDICT: ACCEPT

The construction checks out. The $C_5$ blow-up with clockwise-head coloring is triangle-free, has no rainbow $C_4$, and gives $\delta^c(G)=\lfloor n/5\rfloor+1$. At $n\equiv 4 \pmod 5$ this is $(n+1)/5$, so any bound below $(n+6)/5$ fails there.

The upper bound $(n+6)/5$ is the part I can't verify here. The proposed "structural analysis" is only sketched, not proven. I also recall a published result on rainbow $C_4$ in edge-colored triangle-free graphs with color-degree conditions stating $\delta^c(G)\ge (n+6)/5$ for large $n$ and claiming sharpness, which matches this answer. That recollection is not something I can check in this environment, so my confidence rests on it together with the construction.

CONFIDENCE: 4
